scheme_name: Mukhya Mantri Shahri Ajeevika Guarantee Yojna
other_conditions: Adult members of the household are eligible
Household consists of husband, wife and their minor children, but only adult members may work
Applicant must be a local resident of the Urban Local Body (own house or rent)
Willingness to do unskilled work in projects or sanitation services
No muster‑roll linked work may be assigned under this scheme
benefits_summary: Provides up to 120 days of guaranteed wage employment to adult urban household members, along with skill training and bank‑linked credit support.
